0.why: graddfa.cpp:45-48 reads getVoltage() with no channel; line 51 clamps the result to a floor of 0, so any negative note voltage gives the same output as C4
graddfa.cpp:49 computes cv * 12 * (10/45) + (2/12)/10, clamped to 0 and 10 at lines 51-52, after setChannels(1) at line 54

comment: Source read at commit c13145d. The output is not rounded, so it rises smoothly between notes; C4 gives 0.0167V rather than 0V because of the fixed offset added at graddfa.cpp:49, which puts the value inside the first mode's band rather than on its boundary.
